data.narrative:
Together AI is a Series C AI & Software company seeking valuation calibration against a peer set of 9 private and 1 public comparable (Palantir / PLTR). The most directly relevant peers—Figure AI, Skild AI, and Crusoe Energy—all operate in the same sector and funding stage.

Stage-progression analysis was inapplicable here. The stated $8.3B post-money valuation implies a step-up to $14.1B, which exceeds 20x the company's $530M total capital raised and fails sanity checks; this input was therefore excluded. Peer-median analysis, by contrast, is directly applicable. The median valuation across the three same-stage, same-sector comparables is $14.0B, with a range spanning $10.0B (Crusoe Energy) to $39.0B (Figure AI). This dispersion reflects variance in product maturity and market positioning within the frontier AI segment.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $11.9B to $16.1B, centered at $14.0B median. Key uncertainties include the wide $29B spread in the peer set—Figure AI's $39B valuation creates material upside optionality—and the relative nascency of revenue/unit economics disclosure in this cohort. The $8.3B reported valuation sits meaningfully below the peer median, suggesting either data staleness or a discount to the current market opportunity in generative AI infrastructure.
